package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func (repository *Repository) CompleteInstanceAndEnqueueEvidence(ctx context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance, submission domain.Submission, evidence json.RawMessage) error {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if instance.ID == "" || submission.ID == "" || !json.Valid(evidence) || instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceCompleted ||
		submission.Status != domain.SubmissionPassed || submission.Scope != "FINAL" || instance.FinalSubmissionID != submission.ID ||
		instance.CurrentSubmissionID != submission.ID || instance.CompletedAt == nil || instance.CompletedAt.IsZero() ||
		submission.CompletedAt == nil || submission.CompletedAt.IsZero() || submission.TaskInstanceID != instance.ID ||
		submission.StudentID != instance.StudentID || !validDigest(submission.WorkspaceDigest) || submission.WorkspaceDigest != submission.Snapshot.WorkspaceDigest {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	if len(submission.ValidationRuns) == 0 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	run := submission.ValidationRuns[len(submission.ValidationRuns)-1]
	if err := validateTerminalRun(run); err != nil || run.Status != domain.ValidationRunPassed || run.Outcome != domain.OutcomePass ||
		evidenceIdentityMismatch(evidence, instance, submission) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if submission.RequiresHumanReview && (submission.HumanReview == nil || submission.HumanReview.Decision != "APPROVE" || submission.HumanReview.ReviewerID == "") {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	tx, err := repository.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
	currentInstance, err := instanceForUpdate(ctx, tx, instance.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	currentSubmission, currentRunID, err := submissionForUpdate(ctx, tx, submission.TaskInstanceID, submission.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if currentInstance.StudentID != instance.StudentID || currentInstance.CurrentSubmissionID != submission.ID ||
		currentInstance.FinalSubmissionID != "" && currentInstance.FinalSubmissionID != submission.ID ||
		currentInstance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceValidating && currentInstance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceFinalizing && currentInstance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInReview && currentInstance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceCompleted ||
		currentRunID != run.ID || !sameSubmissionBinding(currentSubmission, submission) ||
		currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionValidating && currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionReviewRequired && currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionPassed ||
		currentInstance.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID != submission.Snapshot.SandboxID {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if !sameCompletionBinding(currentInstance, instance) || !validProgressProjection(instance) || !allRequiredStepsPassed(instance) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if currentInstance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceInReview && (!currentSubmission.RequiresHumanReview || submission.HumanReview == nil || submission.HumanReview.Decision != "APPROVE") {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if currentInstance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceValidating && currentSubmission.RequiresHumanReview {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if currentInstance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceValidating && currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionValidating ||
		currentInstance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceInReview && currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionReviewRequired ||
		currentInstance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceFinalizing && currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionPassed {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if currentInstance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceFinalizing && currentSubmission.RequiresHumanReview && currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionPassed {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if currentInstance.Status == domain.TaskInstanceCompleted {
		if currentSubmission.Status != domain.SubmissionPassed || currentInstance.CompletedAt == nil ||
			!currentInstance.CompletedAt.Equal(*instance.CompletedAt) || currentRunStatus(currentSubmission) != domain.ValidationRunPassed {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		var storedPayload []byte
		err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM practice_student_evidence_outbox WHERE submission_id=$1`, submission.ID).Scan(&storedPayload)
		if err != nil {
			return translateError(err)
		}
		if string(storedPayload) != string(evidence) || currentInstance.FinalSubmissionID != submission.ID {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		candidateInstance := instance
		candidateInstance.Version = currentInstance.Version
		if !sameInstance(currentInstance, candidateInstance) || !sameSubmission(currentSubmission, submission) {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return tx.Commit()
	}
	if currentSubmission.Status == domain.SubmissionPassed && currentRunStatus(currentSubmission) != domain.ValidationRunPassed {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	var storedRun domain.ValidationRun
	if len(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns) == 0 || currentSubmission.ValidationRuns[len(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns)-1].ID != run.ID {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	storedRun = currentSubmission.ValidationRuns[len(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns)-1]
	if storedRun.Status != domain.ValidationRunPending && storedRun.Status != domain.ValidationRunRunning &&
		!(storedRun.Status == domain.ValidationRunPassed && storedRun.Outcome == domain.OutcomePass) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	encodedRun, err := json.Marshal(run)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if storedRun.Status != domain.ValidationRunPassed {
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_validation_runs SET status='PASSED',outcome='PASS',error_classification=NULL,started_at=$2,finished_at=$3,payload=$4::jsonb,updated_at=$3
WHERE id=$1 AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')`, run.ID, nullableTime(run.StartedAt), nullableTime(run.FinishedAt), encodedRun)
		if err != nil {
			return translateError(err)
		}
	} else if !equalJSON(mustJSON(storedRun), encodedRun) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	currentSubmission.Status = domain.SubmissionPassed
	currentSubmission.CompletedAt = submission.CompletedAt
	currentSubmission.UpdatedAt = submission.UpdatedAt
	currentSubmission.HumanReview = submission.HumanReview
	if len(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns) > 0 {
		currentSubmission.ValidationRuns[len(currentSubmission.ValidationRuns)-1] = run
	}
	encodedSubmission, err := marshalSubmission(currentSubmission)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_submissions SET status='PASSED',payload=$2::jsonb,updated_at=$3,completed_at=$4
WHERE task_instance_id=$1 AND id=$5 AND current_run_id=$6`, submission.TaskInstanceID, encodedSubmission,
		currentSubmission.UpdatedAt.UTC(), nullableTime(currentSubmission.CompletedAt), submission.ID, run.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	if submission.HumanReview != nil && submission.HumanReview.Decision == "APPROVE" {
		reviewRaw, err := json.Marshal(*submission.HumanReview)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO practice_review_events(submission_id,task_instance_id,reviewer_id,decision,feedback,reviewed_at,payload)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'APPROVE',$4,$5,$6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (submission_id) DO NOTHING`, submission.ID, submission.TaskInstanceID,
			submission.HumanReview.ReviewerID, submission.HumanReview.Feedback, submission.HumanReview.ReviewedAt.UTC(), reviewRaw)
		if err != nil {
			return translateError(err)
		}
		var reviewPayload []byte
		if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM practice_review_events WHERE submission_id=$1`, submission.ID).Scan(&reviewPayload); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !equalJSON(reviewPayload, reviewRaw) {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}
	instance.Version = currentInstance.Version + 1
	instanceRaw, err := marshalInstance(instance)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_task_instances SET status='COMPLETED',current_submission_id=$2,final_submission_id=$3,
version=$4,payload=$5::jsonb,updated_at=$6,completed_at=$7 WHERE id=$1 AND version=$8`, instance.ID,
		submission.ID, submission.ID, instance.Version, instanceRaw, instance.UpdatedAt.UTC(), nullableTime(instance.CompletedAt), currentInstance.Version)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	_, err = tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO practice_student_evidence_outbox(id,task_instance_id,submission_id,payload)
VALUES ($1,$2,$1,$3::json) ON CONFLICT (submission_id) DO NOTHING`, submission.ID, instance.ID, []byte(evidence))
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	var storedPayload []byte
	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT payload FROM practice_student_evidence_outbox WHERE submission_id=$1`, submission.ID).Scan(&storedPayload); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if string(storedPayload) != string(evidence) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return translateError(tx.Commit())
}

func currentRunStatus(submission domain.Submission) domain.ValidationRunStatus {
	if len(submission.ValidationRuns) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return submission.ValidationRuns[len(submission.ValidationRuns)-1].Status
}

func sameCompletionBinding(current, next domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	return current.ID == next.ID && current.StudentID == next.StudentID && current.TaskRevisionID == next.TaskRevisionID &&
		current.TaskRevisionDigest == next.TaskRevisionDigest && current.StartCommandDigest == next.StartCommandDigest &&
		current.SurfaceClassification == next.SurfaceClassification && current.Locale == next.Locale &&
		current.LearningPathID == next.LearningPathID && current.LearningPathItemID == next.LearningPathItemID && current.RequirementID == next.RequirementID && current.SolutionVariantID == next.SolutionVariantID && current.StartedAt.Equal(next.StartedAt) &&
		sameRevisionBinding(current, next) && sameFrozenSteps(current.Steps, next.Steps) &&
		(current.LearningActionID == "" || current.LearningActionID == next.LearningActionID) &&
		(current.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID == "" || current.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID == next.WorkspaceBinding.SandboxID) &&
		(current.LearningRoute.ID == "" || sameRoute(current.LearningRoute, next.LearningRoute))
}

func allRequiredStepsPassed(instance domain.TaskInstance) bool {
	found := false
	for _, step := range instance.Steps {
		if !step.Required {
			continue
		}
		found = true
		if step.Status != "PASSED" {
			return false
		}
	}
	return found
}

func evidenceIdentityMismatch(raw json.RawMessage, instance domain.TaskInstance, submission domain.Submission) bool {
	var payload map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &payload) != nil {
		return true
	}
	for field, expected := range map[string]string{"learning_path_item_id": instance.LearningPathItemID, "requirement_id": instance.RequirementID} {
		var actual string
		if encoded, exists := payload[field]; exists {
			if json.Unmarshal(encoded, &actual) != nil {
				return true
			}
		}
		if actual != expected {
			return true
		}
	}
	for field, expected := range map[string]string{"evidence_id": submission.ID, "submission_id": submission.ID,
		"task_instance_id": instance.ID, "student_id": instance.StudentID} {
		encoded, exists := payload[field]
		if !exists {
			continue
		}
		var actual string
		if json.Unmarshal(encoded, &actual) != nil || actual != expected {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (repository *Repository) PendingEvidence(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]ports.OutboxMessage, error) {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if limit < 1 || limit > 100 {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	rows, err := repository.db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT outbox.id,outbox.submission_id,instance.student_id,outbox.payload,outbox.attempts
FROM practice_student_evidence_outbox AS outbox
JOIN practice_task_instances AS instance ON instance.id=outbox.task_instance_id
WHERE outbox.delivered_at IS NULL
 AND (outbox.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR outbox.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
 AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM practice_student_evidence_outbox AS earlier
  JOIN practice_task_instances AS owner ON owner.id=earlier.task_instance_id
  WHERE earlier.delivered_at IS NULL AND owner.student_id=instance.student_id
   AND (earlier.created_at,earlier.id) < (outbox.created_at,outbox.id)
 )
ORDER BY COALESCE(outbox.last_attempt_at,outbox.created_at),outbox.created_at,outbox.id LIMIT $1`, limit)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, translateError(err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]ports.OutboxMessage, 0, limit)
	for rows.Next() {
		var item ports.OutboxMessage
		var payload []byte
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.ID, &item.SubmissionID, &item.StudentID, &payload, &item.Attempts); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		item.Payload = append(json.RawMessage(nil), payload...)
		result = append(result, item)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (repository *Repository) MarkEvidenceDelivered(ctx context.Context, messageID string, at time.Time) error {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(messageID) || at.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	result, err := repository.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_student_evidence_outbox SET delivered_at=COALESCE(delivered_at,$2)
WHERE id=$1`, messageID, at.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	affected, err := result.RowsAffected()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if affected != 1 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// MarkEvidenceFailed persists technical retry state without changing the fact.
// A late failure after an ACK is a no-op, so it cannot revive delivered evidence.
func (repository *Repository) MarkEvidenceFailed(ctx context.Context, messageID string, at time.Time, code string) error {
	if err := repository.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(messageID) || at.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	switch code {
	case ports.EvidenceFailurePayloadInvalid, ports.EvidenceFailureIdentityMismatch,
		ports.EvidenceFailureProviderUnavailable, ports.EvidenceFailureReceiptMismatch, ports.EvidenceFailureDeliveryMarker:
	default:
		return domain.ErrInvalid
	}
	result, err := repository.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE practice_student_evidence_outbox
SET attempts=LEAST(attempts::bigint+1,2147483647)::integer,
 last_attempt_at=$2::timestamptz, next_attempt_at=$2::timestamptz + make_interval(secs => LEAST(300,2 * power(2,LEAST(attempts,8)))::double precision),
 last_failure_code=$3 WHERE id=$1 AND delivered_at IS NULL`, messageID, at.UTC(), code)
	if err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	affected, err := result.RowsAffected()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if affected == 1 {
		return nil
	}
	var delivered bool
	if err := repository.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT delivered_at IS NOT NULL FROM practice_student_evidence_outbox WHERE id=$1`, messageID).Scan(&delivered); err != nil {
		return translateError(err)
	}
	if !delivered {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}
